newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD sale still faces nine injunctions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD sale still faces nine injunctions.

text.p: There are at least nine court injunctions that have to be quashed before the sale of Brazil's Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) can go ahead, officials said.
"There are at least nine injunctions that have to be overturned," a spokesman for the National Development Bank (BNDES) said.
The auction of a controlling stake in CVRD had been due to kick off at the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange at 1000 local time/0900 EDT/1300 GMT, but was delayed by the court orders.
Government lawyers across the country are lodging appeals to try and get the sell-off started by 1700 local time/1600 EDT/2000 GMT.
A BNDES spokeswoman said Planning Minister Antonio Kandir and the bank's privatization director Jose Pio Borges were meeting in BNDES headquarters in Rio.
She could not confirm reports that BNDES President Luiz Carlos Mendonca de Barros was on his way back from Brasilia to join Kandir and Borges.
